+-- Migration 001: Allow 'PayMongo' as a payment method.
+--
+-- Context:
+--   tbl_payments.chk_payment_method originally permitted only manual methods
+--   ('GCash', 'GCash QR', 'Cash on Pickup'). PayMongo Hosted Checkout payments
+--   are recorded by the /api/webhooks/paymongo handler and need their own
+--   method value so reporting can distinguish automated from manual payments.
+--
+-- This is a versioned migration for an existing installation. The bootstrap
+-- file (database.sql) is intentionally non-destructive and must NOT be edited
+-- to include this change, per its own header comment.
+--
+-- Idempotency:
+--   MySQL 8.0.16+ / MariaDB 10.2.1+ do not support "DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS"
+--   uniformly across both engines, so this migration is written to be run once
+--   by the migration runner. If your runner does not track applied migrations,
+--   guard the DROP by checking information_schema first (see the note below).
+--
+-- Rollback:
+--   See migrations/001_add_paymongo_payment_method.down.sql
+--
+-- NOTE FOR OPERATORS: Before running, confirm no rows already use a method
+-- outside the original set. This migration only widens the allowed set.
+
+ALTER TABLE tbl_payments
+    DROP CONSTRAINT chk_payment_method;
+
+ALTER TABLE tbl_payments
+    ADD CONSTRAINT chk_payment_method CHECK (
+        method IN ('GCash', 'GCash QR', 'Cash on Pickup', 'PayMongo')
+    );
